title: Modal raises $750M Series D
summary: Modal announced a $750 million Series D led by Accel to expand AI inference, training, and sandbox infrastructure.

title: Clay raises $115M Series D
summary: Wellington led Clay's $115 million Series D as the company expands its self-learning revenue engine and AI growth agents.

title: Harvey announces $550M growth round
summary: Harvey announced a $550 million funding round co-led by Diffusion and Lightspeed Venture Partners to expand legal AI and customer-owned intelligence.

title: NVIDIA agrees to acquire Hugging Face
summary: NVIDIA announced an agreement to acquire Hugging Face and said the platform would continue supporting open models, multiple clouds, and multiple accelerators. Completion is not established.

title: Cursor completes acquisition by SpaceX
summary: Cursor's official company post says SpaceX has completed its acquisition, with Cursor continuing to develop AI coding tools and models.

title: AlphaSense raises $350M and launches SuperAnalyst
summary: AlphaSense announced a $350 million round led by Vitruvian Partners, Accenture Ventures, and J.P. Morgan Asset Management, alongside its always-on SuperAnalyst agent.

title: Rogo raises $160M Series D
summary: Rogo announced $160 million in new financing led by Kleiner Perkins to deepen financial AI integrations and expand deployment across institutions.

title: EliseAI signs expanded NYC headquarters lease
summary: EliseAI announced a 10-year lease for approximately 109,000 square feet at 401 Fifth Avenue, expanding its Midtown New York headquarters.

title: Opentrons announces $40M Series E
summary: Opentrons announced a $40 million Series E led by Avego to standardize AI-driven science on its lab robots. The release identifies its NYC headquarters.

title: Minerva expands its Williamsburg office at the Refinery
summary: Commercial Observer reports expansion from roughly 3,500 to 8,320 square feet at the Refinery at Domino. A company job posting confirms in-person work at 300 Kent Avenue.

title: Chamelio announces $26M Series A
summary: Chamelio announced a $26 million Series A led by Entrée Capital for its AI-native in-house legal operations platform. The event date is the company release, not later news coverage.
